name: @onchainpal/agent-pal
description: Agent-PAL — Autonomous AI coding harness (--pure L0 protocol + run_code sandbox + live host & replay) for classic Chinese Paladin (1995 DOS).

scripts.data:dump: pnpm run build:engine && node bin/agent-pal.mjs data dump --maps all
scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:bench && pnpm run test:pure
scripts.test:unit: node packages/agent-pal-protocol/test/protocol.test.mjs && node test/bytecode-compiler.test.mjs && node test/l0.test.mjs && node test/code-runner.test.mjs && node test/modules.test.mjs && node test/nav.test.mjs && node test/palrec.test.mjs && node --test test/replay.test.mjs
scripts.test:bench: node bench/test/bench.test.mjs && node bench/test/baiyue.test.mjs && node bench/test/battle-metrics.test.mjs && node --test bench/test/provider-cancellation.test.mjs && node bench/bench.mjs validate
scripts.test:pure: pnpm run build:engine && node src/pure-smoke.mjs --skip-if-no-assets && node test/data-dump.test.mjs --skip-if-no-assets && node test/host.test.mjs --skip-if-no-assets
